reason: A DingTalk communication-channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness that connects via Stream WebSocket, supports multimodal message exchange, maintains sessions, and relays Harness agent tool execution with in-chat approvals.

summaries.zh: 通过钉钉 Stream WebSocket 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入单聊和群聊，支持文本与多媒体消息、会话管理及工具审批交互。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to DingTalk direct and group chats over Stream WebSocket with multimodal messaging, session management, and in-chat tool approvals.

capabilities: Connects to DingTalk through the official Stream WebSocket SDK
Receives and sends text, Markdown, rich-text, voice, image, and file messages
Runs DeepSeek Harness Agent Loop turns with structured tool events
Persists isolated conversation sessions and restores agent presets
Uploads generated images and workspace files to DingTalk
Requests and processes one-shot tool approvals through conversation commands
